mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 42 degrees under a new moon.

The city of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains, sanitary sewers, and the addition of new sidewalks and trees between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.

There is plenty to do, including live music at Paddy Mac's today, yoga at Insight Wellness today, and the Wednesday pizza and a pitcher special at Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can also join trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.
On October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they found a 40-year-old man passed out in his vehicle, resulting in an O W I arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note that the store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
